d.ko: Play as a border collie and restore color to your human’s world in an atmospheric journey through the northern isles of Scotland. Explore land and sea, uncover hidden paths, herd animals and free wildlife to bring color back to her world, while revealing an emotional story about saying farewell.

d.zh: 在《告别北方》中，你将扮演一只苏格兰牧羊犬，与主人一起踏上这场氛围独特的开放世界冒险之旅，让荒凉群岛重现昔日光彩。探索陆地和海洋，发现隐藏小径，解救野生动物，让世界恢复多彩生机，同时揭示一个关于告别的感人故事。
